access_model.halt_rule: new value intake soft-fails while the custody invariant is broken

consensus_policy.principle: Exact validator agreement with no numeric tolerance on resolution_band, quantized_strike_baseline_bps, quantized_observed_metric_bps, yes_payout_bps, no_payout_bps, derived_winning_pool_payout, derived_challenger_reward, derived_protocol_reserve_fee and dual_source_corroborated. Every value is re-derived on chain from the fetched prints before it is stored.
consensus_policy.sanitizer: closing tags defused, angle brackets, braces and control characters removed, whitespace collapsed, document truncated to 6000 characters

market_notes.ecb_easing: The secondary source returns a node level load failure, so consensus can never be reached for this book. It is kept on purpose: after the resolution timeout the desk principal is refunded through claim_refund, proving the timeout recovery path.
market_notes.blob_ratio: Two independent hosts carrying the same specification, so the YES band is stable.
market_notes.py_floor: The print falls inside the corridor, so this book exercises the scalar split band.
market_notes.blob_conflict: The two sources describe different upgrades, so the extracted prints are more than one grid step apart. The contract must therefore settle INVALID_OR_AMBIGUOUS_REFUND and refund both desks in full.
market_notes.challenge_book: Book created by scripts/drive_challenge_lifecycle.py: resolved, bonded challenge filed, second challenge attempt soft failed, re-audited by consensus, finalized and claimed.

markets.question: Did the published ECB deposit facility rate for the reference month stand at or above 2500 basis points of the 10000 basis point policy corridor?
markets.criteria: Report the deposit facility rate as an integer from 0 to 10000 basis points of a 10 percent policy corridor, so a rate of 3 percent is 3000. Use only figures printed in the documents. Resolve YES above the strike plus the corridor, NO below the strike minus the corridor, and refund when the two sources cannot be reconciled.

markets.question: Does the EIP-4844 blob target sit at or above 2500 basis points of the per-block blob maximum?
markets.criteria: Report the blob target divided by the per-block blob maximum as an integer from 0 to 10000 basis points, so a target of 3 with a maximum of 6 is reported as 5000. Take the numbers only from the documents. Resolve YES when the print is at or above the strike plus the corridor, NO when it is below the strike minus the corridor, and refund when the documents contradict each other.

markets.question: Does the minimum supported Python version of the requests package sit inside the scalar corridor of its strike?
markets.criteria: Report the minimum supported Python version as an integer from 0 to 10000 by taking the minor version number and multiplying it by 1000, so Python 3.8 is reported as 8000 and Python 3.7 as 7000. Use only the requires-python field printed in the documents.

markets.question: Does the post Pectra blob target reach 7500 basis points of the per-block maximum?
markets.criteria: Report the blob target divided by the per-block blob maximum as an integer from 0 to 10000 basis points, so a target of 3 with a maximum of 6 is 5000 and a target of 6 with a maximum of 9 is 6667. Take the numbers only from the documents.

markets.question: Does the post Pectra blob target reach at least 5000 basis points of the per-block blob maximum?
markets.criteria: Report the blob target divided by the per-block blob maximum as an integer from 0 to 10000 basis points, so a target of 6 with a maximum of 9 is reported as 6667. Take the numbers only from the documents. Resolve YES at or above the strike plus the corridor, NO below the strike minus the corridor, and refund when the documents contradict each other.
